title: power cut in the middle of a system update

clauses.text: a power cut at each step of a system update leaves a machine that starts again by itself, on the saved version when the new one cannot run, and says which

steps.do: Settings, System update: install a pack of the next version, but pull the power while the files are copied to the device (the progress shows the copy). Power on again.
steps.expect: The old version starts as before. System update shows the pack again; Install works a second time.

steps.do: Install again. When the card says the files are being written to the boot partition, pull the power. Power on and wait (the machine may restart once by itself).
steps.expect: The machine reaches the sign-in screen without anybody choosing a boot entry. System update says the update did not finish, or that the saved version started.

steps.do: Install again to the end and restart. When the screen goes dark in the new version's first start (before the first picture), pull the power. Power on twice.
steps.expect: At the latest the second start runs the saved version by itself; System update says the new version fell back.

steps.do: Install again to the end, restart and let the first picture show, then pull the power at once. Power on.
steps.expect: The new version or the saved one starts (never a boot loader prompt); the person's files and settings are intact; System update names the version that runs.
